name: BankrollNetworkStack self-funded buyFor inflation
summary: buyFor() accepted the pool itself as the beneficiary. WBNB.transferFrom(pool, pool, amount) was balance-neutral, but purchaseTokens() still minted internal stake and allocated virtual fees. Repeating that self-funded buy inflated dividends owed to the attacker's real stake, which sell() and withdraw() paid from the pool's WBNB reserve.
notes: The direct BankrollNetworkStack runtime was created in this transaction and remained the execution artifact through the exploit.

The exploit receipt records 16,000 WBNB entering BankrollNetworkStack and 16,412.459593848661728154 WBNB leaving it. The exact transaction-local reserve depletion is therefore 412.459593848661728154 WBNB; the attacker's 404.459593848661728154 WBNB receipt is lower because 8 WBNB repaid the flash-loan fee. DefiLlama observed BNB at $580.89 at timestamp 1727023800, 58 seconds before the exploit.
Campaign: the same buyFor(pool) loop against Ethereum StackPlus DAI 0x7a40ab4b on 2024-09-23 took 489.15 DAI.
